Economics MA at University of St Andrews

What University of St Andrews asks of applicants to Economics MA for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of St Andrews courses · Economics & Finance field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 7 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma:
    • SAT and ACT are test-optional for September 2027 (and September 2028) entry
    • applicants are not penalised for not submitting a score
  • If submitted, St Andrews looks for SAT 1320+ or ACT 28+ (both superscored)
Verified19 Oct 2026St Andrews: USA entry requirements
English language
  • English language profile 3-D (Faculty of Arts, all Schools except English)
  • IELTS Academic (incl. One Skill Retake) or IELTS Online: 7.0 overall with 6.5 in each component
  • TOEFL iBT:
    • 5.0 overall with 4.5 in each section (2026 onwards)
    • 91 overall with Reading 19, Writing 23, Listening 19, Speaking 22 (pre-2026)
  • Cambridge English:
    • 185 overall, 176 in each component
    • PTE Academic: 79 overall, 76 in each
    • Duolingo: 140 overall, 130 in each
    • Oxford ELLT Digital: 9 overall, 8 in each
  • Test scores are normally accepted only if obtained within two years of the programme start date; no test is needed by UK/majority-English-speaking nationals or holders of a qualifying English-medium school-leaving qualification
Verified19 Oct 2026St Andrews: English language requirements for undergraduate students · St Andrews: English language profile 3-D (Arts)
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

St Andrews names the UCAT (for Medicine) as its only admissions test.

Verified19 Oct 2026St Andrews: Academic entry explained
Subject prerequisites
  • No required subject:
    • no previous experience of economics is needed
    • advanced school mathematics is an advantage and an ability to learn mathematical skills is essential

No subject is required; advanced school mathematics is an advantage (coded as preferred Mathematics).

Partly verified19 Oct 2026St Andrews: Economics MA (Honours) 2027 entry
Other qualifications
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma: A or B grades in honours-level courses, or three AP subjects with scores of 4+, judged in the context of the school’s rigour
  • AP scores are used for admissions only; no credit or exemptions are awarded
Verified19 Oct 2026St Andrews: USA entry requirements
Other requirements
  • No interview: St Andrews interviews for Medicine, Gateway and Pathway programmes, part-time study and International Foundation Programmes only
  • A personal statement and a reference are required
